parsed.summary: The proposed patch adds a `do_not_call_in_templates` attribute to the `Choices` class, which should resolve the issue of enumeration types being callable in Django templates. The change is minimal and does not introduce any apparent regressions or compatibility issues.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new attribute `do_not_call_in_templates` which is not aligned with the existing naming conventions in the Django codebase. It would be more consistent to use a naming convention like `django.template.base.DO_NOT_CALL_IN_TEMPLATES`.
